text:
elaine (support): Hey team — customer (Acme Inc) is trying to 'stream' our rerank endpoint and is getting a 415 + empty body. They pasted this curl they ran:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: text/event-stream" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank/stream -d '{"input": ["query"], "candidates": ["a", "b"]}'
```

Response headers: `HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type` then no body. Ticket #12345. They also said before that when they tried application/json they got 422 for "malformed candidates" (looks like they sometimes send nested arrays), and at one point they hit a 401 (used a rotated key without rerank scope). Retries have caused a billing spike for the customer. Can eng triage if this is purely misuse or if we should improve error messages/docs?

sam (eng-runtime): tagging. short answer: rerank does NOT support streaming/SSE. Our public API surface for rerank is non-streaming POST to /v1/rerank (not /v1/rerank/stream). If you call any /stream path or send text/event-stream we currently respond 415 because the runtime doesn't route to the streaming pipeline.

sam (eng-runtime): can you share the raw headers + full request body (redact keys)? also which SDK/client they used? curl above explains the 415. for the 422 "malformed candidates" I'd expect they send something like `[ ["a","b"] ]` instead of `["a","b"]` — our validation rejects nested lists.

elaine (support): here's the payload they pasted: `{"input": "Which product is best?", "candidates": [["Model A","Model B"]]}`. They said they copied an example for ranked lists and accidentally nested the candidates.

raj (eng-ml): nesting explains the 422. our reranker expects candidates: array<string> or array<object> with a `text` field. when it sees an array-of-array the schema validate fails and we return 422. we should provide a clearer error body like: "candidates must be a flat array of strings or objects, got array". currently our validation only sets a generic message from jsonschema. i'll put a small patch to make that explicit.

sam (eng-runtime): on the streaming angle: we should detect `Content-Type: text/event-stream` or `Accept: text/event-stream` and return a friendly 415 with a link to the docs and a short note: "Rerank does not support streaming. Use POST /v1/rerank with Content-Type: application/json." small fix in the router. also ensure the path `/v1/rerank/stream` returns 404/415 rather than falling through to ambiguous behavior.

maria (devex): agree we need clearer customer-facing text. could be a tiny docs blurb + quickstart showing correct curl. sample to send to the customer: 

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -d '{"input": "Which product is best?", "candidates": ["Model A", "Model B"]}'
```

maria (devex): i'll add a note in the rerank docs section about "streaming unsupported" and an explicit validation error example for nested candidates.

alex (billing): small FYI — customer triggered lots of retries (backoff not implemented in their client), ended up with ~180 failed requests in an hour. system billed per request attempt (even failed). they asked for relief. recommend we offer a one-time credit while we improve guidance. pinging CS manager to approve.

elaine (support): thanks. CS manager approved a $150 credit provisional; i'll include the correct curl + explanation and a repro checklist: 1) ensure API key has rerank scope (401 if not) 2) use application/json + POST /v1/rerank (415 if text/event-stream) 3) flatten candidates array (422 if nested) 4) include <= 500 candidates (5xx/429 if you exceed practical limits) 5) exponential backoff for retries.

sam (eng-runtime): quick repro script I ran locally that reproduces the 415: 

```bash
# wrong (triggers 415)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BAD" -H "Content-Type: text/event-stream" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank/stream -d '{"input":"q","candidates":["a"]}' -v

# correct
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GOOD" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -d '{"input":"q","candidates":["a"]}' -v
```

sam (eng-runtime): i'll open a tiny PR to: 1) route /v1/rerank/stream -> 415 with helpful JSON; 2) improve the schema error for nested candidates; 3) add a telemetry tag so we can count how many customers hit streaming attempts in the next 30d. should be low risk.

raj (eng-ml): one more note about "unexpected scores": if customers feed nested objects or pass `scores` along incorrectly, our scorer can return weird distributions. suggest we add a simple pre-flight check that normalizes candidate shapes and returns a clear error if types mismatch. i'll add tests.

infra-bot: deploy queued: small-router-fixes -> staging (sha: a1b2c3) by sam.

maria (devex): i'll draft the customer reply and include the credit, rationale, and the correct curl. also add an FAQ entry: "Why am I getting 415/422/401 on rerank?" with short fixes.

elaine (support): perfect. i'll send a message to the customer now, attach the repro steps and let them know engineering will push the clearer 415 + validation in the next deploy. thanks all :thumbsup:

(Internal followups tracked in ticket #12345)
